subject.title: GitHub OAuth consent still shows personal ClawdHub / steipete branding (reopen of #2524)

question: Should the active production GitHub OAuth App be transferred to an official OpenClaw organization or replaced with a newly created official app, and who is authorized to rotate the Convex production credentials?
rationale: The source contract is clear, but app ownership, secret custody, transfer feasibility, and production credential rotation are privileged administrative decisions that cannot be safely inferred or automated from this repository.

options.title: Transfer or replace now
options.body: Move the OAuth boundary to an official organization-controlled app, rotate production credentials, and require fresh web and CLI consent proof before closing.

options.title: Accept temporary personal ownership
options.body: Keep the current app temporarily only with an explicit owner, deadline, and documented credential-custody plan visible to maintainers.

recommendation.title: Transfer or replace now
recommendation.body: Move the OAuth boundary to an official organization-controlled app, rotate production credentials, and require fresh web and CLI consent proof before closing.

likelyOwner.reason: They were assigned the prior same-root-cause issue and are the best available owner signal for coordinating the privileged production change.
